failure_reason: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) got 403 Access Denied (Akamai bot wall) on every rendered .html page site-wide, though XML sitemaps were fetchable. Tier (b) Playwright headless chromium also got 403 Access Denied on the homepage. Tier (c) claude-in-chrome succeeded initially (homepage and ~14 category pages rendered normally with real product counts) but after roughly 15-20 page loads in the session the same Akamai wall ("Access Denied", errors.edgesuite.net reference) started firing on every subsequent URL, including previously-unvisited ones (bath-shower/bathroom-accessories.html, then shop-by-product/storage.html), and did not clear after two retries with 10-20s waits. Per STEP1 rule 4/1, stopped requesting the host once this recurred at tier (c). Also note: the shared Chrome browser used by claude-in-chrome is contended by other concurrent workers in this environment - several of my own tabs were closed/hijacked mid-task by unrelated navigations (Meesho, Nykaa Fashion) - this cost time but is separate from the Akamai wall itself.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (fetched via tier a, not blocked) explicitly Allow: / for ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai etc, so tier (c) was permitted. Tier (a) and (b) both blocked (403 Access Denied, Akamai). Tier (c) claude-in-chrome worked for a limited window before the same Akamai wall reappeared session-wide; see failure_reason. TREE METHOD: union of (1) en_in.pages.subdepartment.*.xml sitemaps (fetched successfully via tier a even though HTML pages were blocked) filtered to /en_in/home/ paths, and (2) each live category page's own sub-category chip strip, read via claude-in-chrome for the pages that loaded before the wall returned. The site exposes two parallel navigations: 'shop-by-product' (the true category/sub-category hierarchy - department pages like bed-linen, bath-shower, textiles, storage, cooking-dining, cooking-baking, kids-baby) and 'shop-by-room' (bedroom/livingroom/kitchen/bathroom/etc, a room-based re-slice of the same catalogue). Per textile.md/storage.md 'room name is not the classification', only shop-by-product was used as the primary tree; shop-by-room was treated as a redundant duplicate cross-navigation and excluded to avoid double-counting the same SKUs under a second URL. QTY METHOD: exact 'N Products' header text read directly off each rendered category page (or, for two pages with no product grid at all, treated as a confirmed 0 per storage.md #39 / textile.md zero-product handling). Bed Skirts (bed-linen/bed-skirts.html) and Duvet & Sleep Cushions (bed-linen/duvet-pillows.html) both rendered a valid category shell (h1, breadcrumb, chip nav) with no product grid and no count text at all -> recorded qty=0. Bed Spreads (bed-linen/bed-spreads.html, h1 'Blankets, Bedspreads & Throws', 32 Products) is a distinct URL/count from Blankets & Throws (bed-linen/blankets.html, 12 Products) despite overlapping naming, so both were kept as separate rows per the duplicate rule (different listing URLs = different genuine pages) - confidence MEDIUM on Bed Spreads due to the naming overlap. Bath & Shower > Towels (bath-shower/towels.html) is itself a parent with 4 children (bath, beach, guest, hand) so its own URL was not recorded per the parent-URL rule; only the 4 leaf sub-categories were recorded. EXCLUDED: bath-shower/bathroom-accessories.html (never loaded - blocked before content could be confirmed, and its composition - soap dispensers vs bath caddies vs textiles - could not be verified, so it was left out entirely rather than guessed); furnitures/storage.html and its children cabinets/shelves/wardrobes.html (site explicitly places these under Furnitures, not Storage, per storage.md rule 21/27 - Furniture-task scope, not this task); cooking-dining/coasters-placemats.html (mixed hard-coasters + placemats category, composition unverified, excluded rather than forced into Textile); all of decorations/*, home-fragrance/*, lighting/*, flowers-plants, giftwraps, premium, homewear, sleepwear, and the non-textile/non-storage cooking-dining and cooking-baking sub-nodes (plates, cups, cutlery, glassware, chopping-boards, carafes-jugs, cookbooks, kitchen-utensils, serving-platters-bowls, trays, aprons already covered) - all Kitchen & Dining / Decorative / Lighting / apparel, out of scope for this task. MANUAL REVIEW rows: several sub-categories were confirmed to exist (via live chip-bar sighting on textiles.html, or via the en_in subdepartment sitemap with a recent lastmod) but their live product counts could not be read before the Akamai wall returned mid-session; these are recorded with qty=null, link populated, confidence LOW, and flag='MANUAL REVIEW: site blocked (Access Denied) before quantity could be confirmed' rather than fabricated or omitted. A future re-run of this company should prioritize re-checking: Interior Textiles (curtains, rugs/carpets + 5 shape variants, cushions + 2 variants, seat cushions), the cooking-dining/cooking-baking textile items (napkins, tablecloths-runners, tea-towels, kitchen-towels, aprons), kids-baby textile items (bedding, blankets, carpets, cushions, towels), the entire Storage department (storage.html and its 6 children incl. wicker-baskets), kids-baby/storage.html, and bath-shower/bathmats.html and bathroom-accessories.html.
